runs.text: This is the longest life on Earth. Israel is here. Eighty-three years. The top is Hong Kong: eighty-five. What's in the gap? Arab citizens. They <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> as long as Jewish Israelis did twenty years ago. That's the whole gap: two years to the top. Now zoom out. They call Israel a war zone. The world average is seventy-three. The Emirates, eighty-three. Qatar, eighty-two. Lebanon and Jordan, seventy-eight. Iran, seventy-eight. Turkey, seventy-seven. Egypt, seventy-two. Nobody around us lives longer. One honest catch: the Emirates are only a few months behind. We're not perfect. We know it. But a war zone? We <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> longer than anyone around us.
